# EROGIAN

> EROGIAN is an AI-first digital studio based in Enugu & Lagos, Nigeria, building websites, AI chatbots, and business automation systems for small and medium businesses across Africa and globally.

EROGIAN helps businesses launch professional websites with integrated AI chatbots that answer customer questions and capture leads 24/7, automate repetitive workflows (invoicing, follow-ups, appointment booking), and adopt affordable, practical AI tools without needing an in-house technical team.

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://erogian.vercel.app/): Services, pricing, portfolio, and appointment booking for EROGIAN's website, AI chatbot, and automation services
- [Blog](https://erogian.vercel.app/blog): Articles on AI, automation, and web development trends for African small businesses
- [SkillForge](https://erogian.vercel.app/skillforge): Practical video classes on web development, AI, and automation — free and paid tracks
- [About the Founder](https://erogian.vercel.app/about-emmanuel): Background on Emmanuel Ene Rejoice, founder of EROGIAN

## Services

- [Website Development](https://erogian.vercel.app/#services): Responsive, conversion-focused business websites
- [AI Chatbots & Agents](https://erogian.vercel.app/#services): Custom AI chat assistants embedded on websites and WhatsApp
- [Business Automation](https://erogian.vercel.app/#services): Automated lead capture, invoice reminders, and follow-up sequences
- [Branding & Digital Presence](https://erogian.vercel.app/#services): Logo design and brand identity for growing businesses
